outcome: Incidence of unplanned reoperation within 30 days of cesarean birth
cohort: The study cohort comprised 43,492 patients who underwent uncomplicated cesarean birth between January 2019 and December 2021.
finding: Unplanned reoperation occurred in 0.9% of cesarean deliveries, with significant risk factors including smoking, hypertension, bleeding disorders, ASA class > 3, and concurrent myomectomy.
cross-section timing: Data collected between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2021
